name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description: ATO: a non-destructive NDMF tool for VRChat avatars. Analyzes avatar meshes, builds UV->texture mappings, scales UV islands to a target quality, repacks them into one or more atlases to maximize texture utilization while preserving visual fidelity. / ATO：一个用于 VRChat Avatar 的非破坏性 NDMF 工具，分析网格 UV 与贴图的映射关系，按目标质量缩放 UV 岛并重组成图集，在保证质量的同时最大化贴图利用率。
